name: keyboards-mcp
description: Control MIDI hardware synthesizers (Nord Electro 5D, Roland JUNO-X, Prophet-6) from any AI agent: read and change parameters, load programs and set-list songs, and browse extracted backups. Connecting to hardware needs a one-time `keyboards-mcp install` (MIDI Connections Broker daemon, macOS/launchd); the visual no-hardware Mock Runner ships separately.
